method: Direct: IntCal20 marine calibrated; we don't have the mean and standard deviations from OxCal. The above date ranges have been calibrated using a mix of the IntCal20† and Marine20‡ calibration curves. Human bone collagen with a ___C value above -20‰, accompanied by a raised ___N value, is taken to indicate a marine component in the diet. The percentage contribution of this marine component is calculated using end-members of -21.0‰ (fully terrestrial) and -12.5‰ (fully marine) with an uncertainty of 10% applied. The ___C value of -19.4‰ gives a 19% marine contribution (±10%). A regional marine offset (_R) of -150 ± 52 years has been used in the calibration.
